title: Orange Admin API draft types
description: Design draft. Backend enforces scope, MFA, approval, idempotency and domain invariants.

result.description: recorded denotes an immutable event record, not underlying business completion.

request_id.description: Original request correlation when recorded. Null means it was not captured; event_id must not be substituted.

input_price.description: Integer microcredits per 1,000 metered units. 1 credit = 1,000,000 microcredits. Input and output charges round up separately. Both rate and maximum quote must fit signed int64.

output_price.description: Integer microcredits per 1,000 metered units. 1 credit = 1,000,000 microcredits. Input and output charges round up separately. Both rate and maximum quote must fit signed int64.

price_per_minute.description: Positive development microcredits per decoded minute. The ten-minute profile limit must fit signed int64.
